adaptations: RangeGame.cs is byte-for-byte the third external agent implementation source.

Switchback.csproj replaces the local SDK hint with ../reference/Poima.Gameplay.dll, explicitly selects RangeGame.cs, and preserves the original project-derived Switchback assembly name and language/runtime properties.

world.json preserves world identity, revision 5, all 80 entities, all 10 UI elements, selected asset provenance, components and references. Only its five authoring receipts are cleared; already-empty retired-ID bookkeeping is unchanged. JSON is sorted and pretty-printed.
range.poima-input.json preserves the original profile bytes, revision and required committed receipt, with no machine-specific paths.

project.json preserves project identity, name, entry, input profile and audio. Version 1 omits the locally built gameplay artifact; documented publication/adoption installs a verified version-2 selection.
TASK.md preserves the earlier portable adaptation of the same fixed gameplay rules; exercise role metadata will be derived separately from this candidate, not copied from the earlier implementation.
Only the three actively referenced cooked assets and three selected CC0 provenance records are copied. Character and interface sound notices retain their exact original bytes and CRLF line endings.
